description: Fetch one Index Agentica entry by its id (kebab-case slug, e.g. "model-context-protocol"). Returns every field: name, category, summary, description, url, repo, docs, tags, license, pricing, status, agent_access (llms_txt, openapi, mcp_endpoint, auth), related ids, sources, dates and links. If the id is unknown the result is an error with suggested ids.

id.description: Entry id (kebab-case slug) as returned by search.

name: get_entry

entry.description: The full entry, following https://indexagentica.com/schema/entry.schema.json plus a links object.

title: Get directory entry
